preamble: The development of [a] into the rising back diphthong [uo] involves backing and rounding, typically seen as part of a general vowel chain shift.

examples.note: Proto-Uralic *a in the first syllable diphthongized in Proto-Samic (*kuolē); Finnish kala and Hungarian hal keep a simple vowel.

sources: Ladefoged, P. (2001). A Course in Phonetics.
Alkire, T., & Rosen, C. (2010). Romance Languages: A Historical Introduction. Cambridge University Press.
